{"id":1850412526,"question_id":3723,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765216888,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1850412526/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Good Numbers","memory":"27.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int sumOfGoodNumbers(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int sum =0;\n        for(int i=0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++){\n            bool good = true;\n            if(i-k >= 0 and (nums[i] <= nums[i-k])) good = false;\n            if(i+k < nums.size() and (nums[i] <= nums[i+k])) good = false;\n\n            if(good) sum += nums[i];\n        }\n        return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-good-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1278}
